title: How to Restart a Substation
author: Sam Okafor, Grid Engineering
pages: For whoever comes after: a dead substation can be brought back. Seat Grid Couplers in its core to rebuild the links the Heart burned out.
A Coupler is scrap electronics, a battery, copper and a weapon part. Then feed it Energy Cells. When it comes up it will hum, louder than any relay, for about five minutes.
Everything dead for a mile will hear it. Hold the yard until the hum settles.
